Export journal entries to Markdown, CSV, or a full bundle

## Usage

    gournal export [options]

## Options

| Option | Description | Default |
|--------|-------------|---------|
| `-f, --format <format>` | Output format: md, csv, or bundle | `"md"` |
| `-p, --project <project>` | Filter by project name (md and csv only) |  |
| `-t, --tags <tags>` | Comma-separated tags (md and csv only) |  |
| `--from <date>` | Start date (inclusive, md and csv only) |  |
| `--to <date>` | End date (inclusive, md and csv only) |  |
| `-o, --output <file>` | Write to a file instead of stdout |  |
